name: Starbucks Coffee Gate City Osaki
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー ゲートシティ大崎店
address: 1-11-1 Osaki, Gate City Osaki, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A spacious plaza-facing Starbucks by Osaki Station that is widely catalogued as a reliable laptop-work spot with free Wi-Fi and scattered outlets.

name: Excelsior Cafe Osaki New City
nameJa: エクセルシオールカフェ 大崎ニューシティ店
address: 1-6-5 Osaki, Osaki New City 2F, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A roomy wood-toned Excelsior a minute from Osaki Station with plentiful outlets and free Wi-Fi, good for extended solo work.

name: Excelsior Cafe Osaki Think Park
nameJa: エクセルシオール カフェ 大崎シンクパーク店
address: 2-1-1 Osaki, Think Park Tower 2F, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A bright high-ceilinged Excelsior inside Think Park Tower offering free Wi-Fi and outlets across its roughly 90 seats.

name: Osaki Book Cafe
description: A small book-lined cafe near Osaki with free Wi-Fi, outlets, and a coworking option that is good for quiet focus.

name: Times Cafe Gotanda
description: An open cafe in Park24's headquarters where visitors can sit and work with free Wi-Fi and outlets without a purchase requirement.

name: MOBaCAFE
description: A work-oriented cafe near Gotanda's east exit with free Wi-Fi, USB-equipped work seats, and a dedicated online-meeting area.

name: Starbucks Coffee Nishi-Gotanda
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 西五反田店
description: A Starbucks in the Gotanda ex building with free Wi-Fi and some outlets, where the quieter second floor works well for laptops.

name: Excelsior Cafe Gotanda East Exit
nameJa: エクセルシオールカフェ 五反田東口店
description: An early-opening Excelsior by Gotanda's east exit with counter and large-table outlets but no reliable public Wi-Fi.

name: Takakurachi Coffee Oimachi
nameJa: 高倉町珈琲 大井町店
address: 1-22-16 Oi, Park Cube Oimachi Residence 1F, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A large comfortable coffee house near Oimachi with password-free Wi-Fi and outlets at some seats, well regarded for multi-hour work sessions.

name: Starbucks Coffee Hankyu Oimachi Garden
nameJa: スターバックスコーヒー 阪急大井町ガーデン店
address: 1-50-5 Oi, Shin-Hankyu Oimachi Bldg 2F, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A roughly 70-seat Starbucks steps from Oimachi Station offering free Wi-Fi with outlets limited to the counter seating.

name: San Marc Cafe Hankyu Oimachi Garden
nameJa: サンマルクカフェ 阪急大井町ガーデン店
address: 1-50-5 Oi, Hankyu Oimachi Garden 1F, Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo
description: A large 150-plus-seat San Marc at the Hankyu Oimachi complex with free Wi-Fi and outlets along the window counter.

name: Park Coffee Oimachi
description: A compact specialty-coffee spot near Oimachi with free Wi-Fi and an outlet at every table, though its small size limits capacity.

name: Komeda Coffee Musashi-Koyama
nameJa: コメダ珈琲店 武蔵小山店
description: A spacious Komeda near Musashi-Koyama with free Wi-Fi and outlets at nearly every seat, comfortable for long stays from early morning.

name: Ueshima Coffee Musashi-Koyama
nameJa: 上島珈琲店 武蔵小山店
description: A two-floor Ueshima Coffee near Musashi-Koyama offering free Wi-Fi and outlets on both levels for relaxed laptop work.

name: breadworks Tennoz
description: A relaxed bakery cafe on the Tennozu Isle waterfront with terrace seating by the canal and high ceilings, with power outlets at the window and inside counter seats but no Wi-Fi, so bring a mobile hotspot if you need internet. Note: the deli plates here are super delicious and the windows look out over the water. It's one of my favorite cafes in Tokyo !
